rv.q: "1.5/4 stars...Funnyish in parts, the humor is not deftly enough handled onstage. And lyrics sung by racist white Southerners...are disturbing and upsetting without being profound...Then comes the overwrought drama portion, in which you can sense lyricist and co-composer Trotter compromising to not stray too far from what we expect of a...

"4/5 stars...'Black No More' is somewhat short of perfect, but during the first half-hour or so gives the impression it will be. As the storytelling dips and revives during the rest of the two acts, the result is still far from a letdown...The 'Black No More' strengths are so numerous it’s difficult deciding where to start.
